# Operations Service Standards Review and Updates

This document outlines key action items for the review and monitoring of operational service standards.

*   Review the cash flow standard update.
*   Monitor the customer wait time standard update.
*   Review the customer wait time quarterly.
*   Review the branch efficiency quarterly.
*   Optimize the cash flow based on audit findings.
